instruction:
Reconstruct the final tower described by these successive speech messages from one trial. Later messages can correct earlier ones. A correction that depends on an unseen Builder state may remain ambiguous.

Message 1: All right, we're making our favorite C shape again, this time on the left side of the grid. So it's going to be with the open bit of the C facing away from you. So green, red, green on top. And again, the open bit is facing away from you. This is all on the left side of the grid.

assumptions: The 'C shape' is constructed with two green blocks oriented along the z-axis (2x1x4) as the horizontal arms, and one red block oriented along the y-axis (2x4x2) as the vertical connector.
The green blocks are placed at x=0, spanning the left column.
The red block is placed at the front end of the green blocks (z=2 to z=4) to create the opening towards the back (z=0 to z=2), which corresponds to 'facing away from you'.
